## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Market strength in SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) and XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) confirmed, while risk/cycle ratios are mixed (VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -4.38% | 1M: -5.84%) ↓ falling; HYG/LQD near flat).

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Credit signals neutral: HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +0.31%) and LQD RECOVERY (1W: +0.72% | 1M: -0.65%) show limited spread movement. Volatility easing: VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -4.38% | 1M: -5.84%) ↓ falling, supporting risk appetite but not decisively.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Neutral: TLT RECOVERY (1W: +1.03% | 1M: -1.65%) and HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +0.31%) leave financial conditions mixed rather than tightening or loosening.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Tech and Materials leading: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) and XME ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.99% | 1M: +12.11%) showing strength, while Energy XLE in CORRECTION (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) and Utilities XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -3.37%) lag. Style: Growth leadership (XLK/XLF both positive) but cyclicals also participating.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US leads: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) and QQQ RECOVERY (1W: +5.09% | 1M: -0.03%) outperform EM/China, where EEM RECOVERY (1W: +2.42% | 1M: -1.71%) and FXI CORRECTION (1W: -0.90% | 1M: +8.26%) show mixed dynamics.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculation improving: ARKK RECOVERY (1W: +11.50% | 1M: -2.58%) and IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +2.76%) alongside small caps IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +1.45%).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Precious metals leadership: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +5.37%) and SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +6.21%); copper CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +5.70%) supports industrial demand.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy mixed: BNO CORRECTION (1W: -6.85% | 1M: +11.29%) and USO CORRECTION (1W: -8.66% | 1M: +8.23%) show short-term pullbacks versus positive 1M, while natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -10.06%) weakens.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: Broad sector breadth (8/11) and equity leadership in SPY and XLK (both ABOVE TREND). DIVERGENCE: Energy and select commodity/China ETFs show 1W/1M mismatches (multiple CORRECTION flags) — divergence severity MINOR.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor growth/momentum exposure given XLK ABOVE TREND and broad sector strength; reduce exposure to lagging defensives (XLU BELOW TREND) and monitor energy CORRECTIONs. Bonds remain mixed/neutral given TLT RECOVERY.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%), XME ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.99% | 1M: +12.11%).  
BEARISH: XLE CORRECTION (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%), XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -3.37%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +5.37%), SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +6.21%).  
BEARISH: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -10.06%), USO CORRECTION (1W: -8.66% | 1M: +8.23%).

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX ~20 for complacency (VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -4.38% | 1M: -5.84%)); HYG/LQD parity ~0.80 for credit health (HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +0.31%) / LQD RECOVERY (1W: +0.72% | 1M: -0.65%)); monitor XLK/ XLF spread as growth vs value pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, equity breadth supports a constructive stance even as macro ratios remain mixed. Tech and materials showing relative strength (XLK ABOVE TREND; XME ABOVE TREND) while energy CORRECTIONs and commodity divergences are the key risks to monitor.
